definitions: A pattern in technical analysis indicating an uptrend where each successive peak (high) and trough (low) is higher than the preceding one.
To show consistent upward momentum in price or value over time.
examples: The stock continued to make higher highs and higher lows, signaling a strong bull market.
Analysts noted that the cryptocurrency was starting to make higher highs and higher lows, suggesting a potential recovery.
lemma: make higher highs and higher lows
